definitions.gloss: to writhe (in pain), to squirm, to wriggle in agony
definitions.explanation: To twist and move one's whole body intensely due to pain, discomfort, or strong emotion. More emphatic than {悶|もだ}える.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激痛|げきつう}→激痛：17165_gekitsuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身悶|みもだ}える
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{苦|くる}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身悶|みもだ}え⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
{恥|は}ずかしさ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{身悶|みもだ}え⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made such an embarrassing mistake that I wanted to squirm.

notes:
FORMATION: Compound of ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (body) + ⟦{悶|もだ}える→悶える：09137_modaeru⟧ (to writhe). The prefix ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ emphasizes the involvement of the whole body.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧).

CONJUGATION: Ichidan verb: {身悶|みもだ}えない, {身悶|みもだ}えます, {身悶|みもだ}えて.

USAGE: Often used figuratively for emotional distress (embarrassment, frustration) where one metaphorically wants to writhe.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧/⟦{苦|くる}しみ→苦しみ：14120_kurushimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身悶|みもだ}える (to writhe in pain/agony)
- {恥|は}ずかしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身悶|みもだ}える (to squirm with embarrassment)
- {身悶|みもだ}え⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ほど (to the point of writhing)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{悶|もだ}える→悶える：09137_modaeru⟧ (to writhe - less emphatic)
- のたうち{回|まわ}る (to roll around in agony)
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よじる→よじる：17575_yojiru⟧ (to twist one's body)
